parsed.why: Statute expressly criminalises changing sex at birth (5-10 yrs, no mitigation), plus state-directed crackdown: dozens arrested, witch-hunt climate. State is the perpetrator; transition itself illegal. Near-extreme.

Enforced sodomy law (5-10 yrs) with documented mass arrests, plus new ban on promoting 'transsexuality'; trans people recorded facing prosecution and violence. Active police lever, though not an express cross-dressing/trans ban.

Fourteen-year sodomy statute but no recorded prosecutions and no trans-specific evidence either way; thin data resolves toward the no-protection, criminalised regime, discounted because enforcement is documented as dormant.

No criminalisation, self-declaration, functioning institutions, but documented rising anti-trans hate incidents (229) and survey prevalence (1 in 5 threatened, 8% assaulted). Reduced risk, short of Low.

No criminalisation and working hate-crime grounds (two-year sentence), but severe societal hostility, ineffective hate-speech prosecution, hostile mayor and Pride attack. Tier-3 hostility with partial recourse.
